system.description:
Shadowcast Traits

When you choose this heritage at first level, select the traits from an existing heritage. This represents your counterpart on the Material Plane and reflects your physical appearance, the rate at which you age, and any additional senses or features you may acquire. Additionally, you gain the following trait, regardless of selection:

Darkvision. You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision as a result of your choice of traits, your darkvision instead increases out to 120 feet.

Shadowcast Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your counterpart’s heritage, select one of the following gifts:

Shielded by Darkness

You gain proficiency in Stealth, or an expertise die if you were already proficient.

Additionally, when you are in dim light or total darkness, you may add an expertise die to Stealth checks.

Shadow Teleport

So long as you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you may teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied square that you can see. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Umbral Magic

You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.omvngnmoo75is54f]{Spare the Dying} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.bpkked98u8mb2q3w]{Chill Touch} cantrip. At 3rd level, you learn either @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.it4gev1vr8gmecok]{False Life} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.5qkmd21kyg7vedcz]{Inflict Wounds}. At 5th level, you learn either @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.6q34ttse78toj5x0]{Blindness/Deafness} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.0ou0qutr7p2bedg0]{Darkness}. You may cast these spells once per long rest without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. Your spellcasting modifier for these spells is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.

Shadowcast Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better shadowcast and gain one paragon gift from the following list:

Animated Shadow

As an action, your shadow may split away and move independently from you. This shadow acts on your turn, has a movement speed of 30 feet, claws that count as natural weapons, and has a number of hit points equal to 10 + your proficiency bonus. Its AC is 10.

The shadow acts on your initiative and has one attack, and any attacks that it makes uses your attack bonus (Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher). On a hit, it deals 2d6 necrotic damage to the target. You may issue a command to your shadow or reattach your shadow to you as a bonus action. If you do not issue a command to your shadow on your turn, it merely defends itself. If your shadow dies, it immediately reattaches itself to you. Once you have used this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

Incorporeal Form

As a bonus action, you may become incorporeal. While in this form, you are still visible but semi-transparent, you cannot attack, and attacks from nonmagical weapons cannot harm you. You may pass through solid objects and interact with them. You may stay in this incorporeal state for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier, until you choose to voluntarily end it as a bonus action, or until you take damage. This ability may be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Writhing Darkness

You learn the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.67ex7mn5kkutvnqn]{Black Tentacles} and can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. Your spellcasting modifier for this spell is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.
